Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (specifically Co-IP) to study the interactome of AGT1 isoforms. Quantification was performed via spectral counting (LFQ).

scope: Co-immunoprecipitation was performed using the Pierce’ Co-Immunoprecipitation Kit

Two milligrams of soluble cell lysate from untransfected (negative control) or transfected cells (AGT–Ma and AGT–Mi) were incubated with 10 µg of polyclonal anti-AGT primary antibody, immobilized on column
The samples were eluted from the column using SDS buffer
After immunoprecipitation, the protein eluates were precipitated overnight with ice-cold acetone (1:4 v/v) and subjected to sample preparation for proteomics

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on material isolated via co-immunoprecipitation (anti-AGT antibody) from HEK293 cell lysates, fitting the 'affinity-purified complex scope'.
